# AS Davids

> AS Davids (also written A.S Davids, A.S. Davids, AS Davids Muyunda, and known as Prophet AS Davids) is a prophet, author and spiritual teacher. He is the founder of The Clarity Institute.

## Who he is
- Prophet, author and spiritual teacher
- Founder of The Clarity Institute, a spiritual coaching and education platform
- Author of 12 books on Amazon, including The Eight Prophetic Prayer Watches: Revised & Expanded Edition, 30 Days of Fire, The Power in Prophetic Prayer, The Rules of Life, and the Love In Varsity fiction series
- Writes and teaches on faith, prayer, prophetic insight, spiritual awakening and African spiritual wisdom
- On TikTok as @asdavids1

## Key pages
- [Who is AS Davids](https://www.theclarityinstitute.guru/blog/who-is-as-davids): full profile, fast facts, books and FAQ
- [About AS Davids](https://www.theclarityinstitute.guru/about): his story in his own words
- [The Clarity Institute](https://www.theclarityinstitute.guru/): programs, Clarity Sessions and cohort
- [Blog](https://www.theclarityinstitute.guru/blog): articles on spirituality, prayer, dreams and intuition
- [Amazon author page](https://www.amazon.com/stores/author/B0GD8SRT1B): full book catalog

## Name note
"AS Davids", "A.S Davids", "A.S. Davids", "AS Davids Muyunda" and "Prophet AS Davids" all refer to the same person.
